aggregation.diagnostic_identity: the diagnostic code string identifies a failure class, not an occurrence or failed-field record
aggregation.factor_container_short_circuit: missing factor_state emits only FACTOR_STATE_MISSING; non-object factor_state emits only FACTOR_STATE_TYPE_INVALID; do not descend
field_non_cascade: a missing field suppresses its type, domain and dependent diagnostics
an invalid type or format suppresses domain, threshold, temporal and version-dependent diagnostics for that field
confidence outside [0,1] emits FACTOR_CONFIDENCE_OUT_OF_RANGE and not FACTOR_CONFIDENCE_BELOW_MIN
FACTOR_CONFIDENCE_BELOW_MIN applies only to a valid in-domain value below 0.5
invalid observed_at suppresses stale and future diagnostics
PUBLISHED_SUBSET_AMBIGUOUS is evaluated only after both contracts are valid
aggregation.host_short_circuit: if any host error exists, disposition is rejected; report only ordered host diagnostics and do not validate factor, modulate, classify or create a modulation trace
aggregation.independent_failure_policy: aggregate the complete set of independently detected diagnostic code classes, deduplicate by code, and sort by the fixed 1-22 priority
aggregation.same_code_multiple_fields: represent the independently detected diagnostic class once even when multiple fields produce that same code

source_id.accepted_form: non-empty NFC JSON string containing at least one non-whitespace code point
source_id.failure_rule: a present value that is not already in the accepted form is rejected without trimming or silent Unicode normalization

authorized_precedence: published source material is preserved verbatim and may only be referenced through an explicit adapter
doctoral decisions may adapt names and execution structure but may not rewrite source labels or source claims
thesis fields bind only to their declared targets and may not silently override published content
any undeclared collision, missing binding or incompatible type fails closed
resolution.conflict_policy: any undeclared collision, missing binding or incompatible type fails closed

policy.global_adapter_precedence: for 2018a and 2018b antecedent fields, these source-specific maps are the sole executable adapters; global_allowed_lexical_adapters is descriptive shorthand and cannot relax exact matching
policy.preservation_rule: retain every source lexeme with its original spelling, capitalization, hyphenation and spacing in the published layer; emit canonical keys only in decisions and resolved layers

policy.match_rule: resolve only by the declared source_id and exact source lexeme; cross-source substitution, abbreviation inference and fuzzy matching are prohibited
